threads.label: Strait of Hormuz blockade narrative
threads.summary: Regime channels amplified claims that Iran controls the Strait of Hormuz, with Defa Press asserting a blockade has caused bitumen shortages in France and IRIB citing Al Jazeera on a 'shadow fleet' evading a US naval blockade. Khamenei's office published a review of Mojtaba Khamenei's views on managing the strait, and a new mural titled 'Cornered' was unveiled in Tehran's Valiasr Square.

threads.label: Iran diplomatic outreach after war
threads.summary: IRIB reported a phone call between Foreign Minister Araghchi and Russia's Lavrov on ending the war, while Defa Press said Araghchi also spoke with counterparts in Turkey, Egypt, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Iraq and Azerbaijan. Iran International reported Pezeshkian and Ghalibaf are seeking Araghchi's removal, accusing him of following IRGC chief instructions in nuclear talks.

threads.label: Workers' Day messaging from Tehran
threads.summary: Khamenei's office trailed a forthcoming Mojtaba Khamenei message for Workers' Day and Teachers' Day, echoed by IRIB and Defa Press. Parliament Speaker Qalibaf and President Pezeshkian issued Workers' Day statements praising labourers and pledging to safeguard workers' rights.

threads.label: Regime claims of US weakness post-war
threads.summary: IRIB cited the New York Times, Foreign Affairs, The Hill and a Quincy Institute outlet in claims that the US military was exposed, public opposition to the Iran war matched Iraq and Vietnam levels, and the oil shock harmed America. Defa Press reported a fire disabled the USS Higgins destroyer in the Pacific, citing CBS News.

threads.label: UK sanctions guidance and Iran International reporting
threads.summary: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office published statutory guidance on the Iran, Iran nuclear and Yemen sanctions regimes. Iran International reported Tehran residents displaced by the 40-day war facing eviction from hotels, Canada's government under pressure over football chief Mehdi Taj's entry, and economic factors shaping the Iran–US standoff.

As a result, many construction projects including road repairs in summer face rising costs. events.title_en: Foreign Affairs: How did war lead to preserving Iran's system? — The unintended consequence of the joint American-Israeli attack was that Iran's system consolidated amid the storm
events.summary_en: Foreign Affairs: How did war lead to preserving Iran's system? — The unintended consequence of the joint American-Israeli attack was that Iran's system consolidated amid the storm. Washington and Tel Aviv strategists believed military pressure would cause the people to rise against the government. But this attack awakened Iranian nationalism. Now even domestic critics have stood alongside the system to defend the soil and territorial integrity. American and Israeli attacks caused Iran's network of allied groups in the region (the axis of resistance) to enter the fray with redoubled motivation. This war transformed the bond between Tehran and its allied groups from a political relationship into a 'blood-soaked common fate' that has strengthened Iran's influence

events.title_en: Fire grounds American destroyer in Pacific Ocean — American media reported that the USS Higgins destroyer of the United States Navy, following a major fire, became disabled in the Pacific Ocean and remained without power and propulsion system for a period
events.summary_en: Fire grounds American destroyer in Pacific Ocean — American media reported that the USS Higgins destroyer of the United States Navy, following a major fire, became disabled in the Pacific Ocean and remained without power and propulsion system for a period. According to CBS News reporting, the fire occurred in one of the main technical sections of this vessel and caused a power cut and failure of the propulsion system of the Arleigh Burke-class destroyer; a situation that in maritime terminology is referred to as 'dead in the water'. This incident occurred as the American Navy in recent months has faced questions about operational readiness and the wear and tear of certain equipment

events.title_en: Telephone conversations of our Foreign Minister with regional foreign ministers — Seyyed Abbas Araghchi held telephone conversations with regional foreign ministers
events.summary_en: Telephone conversations of our Foreign Minister with regional foreign ministers — Seyyed Abbas Araghchi held telephone conversations with regional foreign ministers, including Turkey, Egypt, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Iraq and the Republic of Azerbaijan. Seyyed Abbas Araghchi, our Foreign Minister in telephone contact with regional foreign ministers, including Turkey, Egypt, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Iraq and the Republic of Azerbaijan, briefed them on the latest positions and initiatives of the Islamic Republic of Iran regarding ending the war and American and Zionist regime aggression.

events.title_en: Pezeshkian: The powerful arms of workers are the government's support in the path of rebuilding the country — The President described being a worker
events.summary_en: Pezeshkian: The powerful arms of workers are the government's support in the path of rebuilding the country — The President described being a worker as beyond a profession and a symbol of dignity, steadfastness and future-building and emphasised the government's commitment to safeguarding workers' rights, job security and improving their living standards. Masoud Pezeshkian, the President, in a message on the occasion of International Workers' Day, recalled with appreciation and sympathy the women and men who with powerful hands, unbreakable wills and creative minds have kept Iran's pillars of prosperity and progress standing firm. events.title: Tehran residents face eviction from hotels after war damage
events.summary: Dozens of residents in Tehran displaced by a 40-day war with the US and Israel said municipal authorities ordered them to vacate temporary hotel housing despite unsafe homes and limited aid, according to interviews published by Etemad newspaper on Thursday.

events.title: Ottawa on defensive after Iran football chief linked to IRGC entered Canada
events.summary: Canada’s government is under pressure to explain how Mehdi Taj, Iran’s football chief and a former intelligence officer of the Revolutionary Guards, was briefly allowed into the country after being granted a special permit despite Canada’s IRGC ban.

events.title: Economics may decide outcome of Iran-US standoff
events.summary: The next phase of the Iran–US standoff may be decided not on the battlefield, but by how much economic pressure each side can withstand.

events.title: United States Condemns the Pro-Hamas Global Sumud Flotilla
events.summary: The United States condemns the Global Sumud Flotilla, a pro-Hamas initiative and a baseless, counterproductive effort to undermine President Trump’s Peace Plan. This Pro-Hamas Flotilla is organized by an OFAC-sanctioned entity, the Popular Conference for Palestinians Abroad, which was designated as a specially designated global terrorist in January for operating at Hamas’ behest. The founder of the Global Sumud Flotilla has publicly expressed support for the Iranian regime and its terror proxies

events.title: Pezeshkian, Ghalibaf seek Araghchi’s ouster over 'subservience' to Guards
events.summary: Iran's president and parliament speaker are seeking Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi’s removal, accusing him of following the Revolutionary Guard chief’s instructions in nuclear talks without informing the president, two sources familiar with the matter told Iran International.
